title: Installer's Onsite Sewage Disposal System Certification

rule.due: Completed CEP-5 to the LHD within 3 business days of system completion (intervening holiday: next LHD business day).
rule.approvalForUse: LHD issues Approval for Use only after signed installer statement (and engineer CEP-6 if required).

notThisForm: CEP-2 / CEP-3 permit to install or repair
prefillImplication: Office and job records can draft identity, permit, tank, and system-type fields. Certification text, signature, license/exempt, sketch, and not-inspected attestation cannot be auto-completed honestly. Prefill is a draft, never ADPH approval.

fields.label: LHD
fields.notes: County local health department. Often stamped/filled when received; office may know which LHD from site county.

fields.label: Permit #
fields.notes: From CEP-2/CEP-3 Permit to Install or Repair. Often held by owner, builder, or soil professional—not always in the installer CRM.

fields.label: Date Rec.
fields.notes: LHD received-stamp. Do not invent in the app.

fields.label: Owner/Applicant’s Name
fields.notes: May differ from payer, site contact, or deed holder. Map to property-owner / permit-applicant, not invoice name by default.

fields.label: Property (911) Address
fields.notes: Site address, not billing or shop.

fields.label: Subdivision Name
fields.notes: Often missing on rural parcels.

fields.label: Installation Date
fields.notes: When work actually finished, not when scheduled. Jobs may span days.

fields.label: New / Repair
fields.notes: Set from job type. Waiver repairs (CEP-5A) are still Repair and still need CEP-5.

fields.label: Septic Tank Size (Gallons)
fields.notes: Knowable from a tank sale if this company poured the tank; otherwise field or permit.

fields.label: Manufacturer’s #
fields.notes: Yard/manufacturer number when this company made the tank; otherwise stamped on the tank in the field.

fields.label: Septic Tank Filter (NSF 46) Installed Yes / No-not-required
fields.notes: Permit may say required; crew confirms installed.

fields.label: Advanced Treatment Unit Make
fields.notes: If applicable. Added on 8/2025 vs older CEP-5.

fields.label: Type of Distribution System
fields.notes: Usually on permit/plot plan; crew confirms what was built.

fields.label: System Type
fields.notes: From permit/design. 8/2025 field.

fields.label: EDF Depth/Height (inches)
fields.notes: Measured on site. Below NGS / Above NGS. Fill inches if applicable.

fields.label: EDF Size
fields.notes: Linear feet or square feet. Permit has design size; field records as-built.

fields.label: EDF Size unit (linear feet / square feet)
Separate Washer Line width and length
Installer Name / Company
fields.notes: Company name from the tenant; named installer is the AOWB licensee, not necessarily the excavator.

fields.label: Business Address / City / State / Zip / Telephone
fields.notes: Shop address and phone from the tenant profile, not hardcoded to one company.

fields.label: Permit issued by LHD on (Date)
fields.notes: Inside the certification paragraph. From the permit, not the job date.

fields.label: License Number or Exempt (owner/primary residence)
fields.notes: License belongs to a person. Exempt path is owner installing on a primary residence, not a typical contractor case.

fields.label: Signature
fields.notes: Legal attestation by licensee. Never auto-sign.

fields.label: SYSTEM LAYOUT sketch
fields.notes: Required when authorized to cover after LHD had opportunity to inspect. A photo of a hole is not a sketch.

sourceLegend.office: Knowable from customer, job, tank sale, or tenant shop constants before or without a hole in the ground.
sourceLegend.field: As-built, measured, sketched, or attested on site (or back at the shop the same day).
sourceLegend.lhd: Originates on the permit or at the health department; the installer copies it, does not create it.
